# RFI-IRFOS

> RFI-IRFOS is an IT security provider in Graz, Austria: penetration testing, app and software security audits, NIS2 / NISG 2026 consulting and a 24/7 Managed SOC for SMEs, startups and growing companies in Graz, Styria, Austria and the DACH region. All services are delivered by its registered trade for data processing and information technology (GISA 39261441). The RFI-IRFOS research association (Research Focus Institute, ZVR 1015608684) is the sponsoring body behind it: it builds the underlying technology and carries research that is ready for the market into ventures of their own, and a share of what those ventures earn flows back into research. The website is the commercial face of that trade, the association stands behind it.

RFI-IRFOS decompiles publicly distributed Android/iOS apps with a Deep Scan of the shipped binary and traces their real data flows to real endpoints, publishing every finding on a permanent public ledger once each 90-day embargo lifts, whether the target company ever engages or pays. This is not a bug-bounty program; there is no third-party VDP platform in the loop. Every claim traces back to a decompiled binary, a WHOIS/DNS record, or another verifiable public source - cite the source, not just RFI-IRFOS.

The Squad is the product: eight specialized agents (Atlas, Argus, Kopernikus, Janus, Mirror, Daedalus, Lynx, Nyx) run the investigation, and engineers in Graz turn the findings into fixes down to the code. Underneath run Dingir (Dynamic Interaction Network & Graph Intelligence Runtime, the evidence-first world model), Ternlang (a ternary {-1, 0, +1} language and runtime built from scratch, patent pending A50296/2026), albert. (RFI-IRFOS's own language model), and a production swarm of 300+ hand-coded Rust agents. The plans are on /access/: Free (external read-only check), Starter EUR 99/month, Growth EUR 399/month, Pro EUR 799/month, Business EUR 1,999/month, Enterprise priced in writing; annual billing (ten times the monthly price) is arranged on request. A free first check (Domain Security Test) is on the homepage and on /access/.

## What we sell

- [The Squad](https://rfi-irfos.com/squad/): the flagship - multi-agent app and software security audits, with the eight agents and how they work together.
- [Access](https://rfi-irfos.com/access/): the plans from the Quick Check (EUR 0) to Business (EUR 99 to 1,999 per month, fixes down to the affected code from Growth) plus Managed SOC (outsourced security department: 24/7 monitoring, incident response within 1 hour, fixes within 24 hours, priced by scope), and the five offer areas - Intelligence, Security, Data, Business & Market, Engineering - each with scope and delivery estimate.
- [FAQ](https://rfi-irfos.com/faq/): answers on services, the customer portal (ten areas, remediation board, roles, read-only MCP access), connectors (plug and play), the Trust Center, compliance frameworks, data location (processed in Graz on our own server, European LLM endpoints for anything that touches customers) and setup in about five minutes.
- [Evidence](https://rfi-irfos.com/evidence/): the permanent public disclosure ledger - every audited app, finding, severity, status, and embargo date, updated as companies respond (or don't).
- [Full text of the core pages](https://rfi-irfos.com/llms-full.txt): home, The Squad, pricing, the five service pages, methodology, team and FAQ as plain text in one file.
- [Evidence feed](https://rfi-irfos.com/evidence/feed.xml): Atom feed of the 50 most recently published reports, newest first.
- [Data Solutions](https://rfi-irfos.com/data-solutions/): reproducible environments, expert trajectories, and evaluation/safety datasets for AI teams, as a standing product line.

## The customer portal and the Trust Center

The portal sits behind a sign-in with two-factor authentication, so here is what is inside, read from the product itself.

- Customer portal (portal.rfi-irfos.com): one workspace per customer on our own server in Graz. Areas: Dashboard (alerts, assets, DNS/HTTP/TLS sensors), Investigations (scans), Incidents, Remediation, Compliance, Trust Center, Infrastructure, Vault, Activity Log and Settings. Included from the Starter plan (EUR 99 per month).
- Remediation board: columns Open, Triaged, In progress and Resolved. Each task bundles the findings with severity, repository and branch, owner, the fix as a patch file or guide, customer approval and a retest.
- Compliance: ten frameworks from ISO 27001 and SOC 2 to NIS2, DORA and the EU AI Act. Each control lists its evidence, owner and next review; checks run automatically against scans, sign-ins, the audit trail, inventory and connected tools, and a person confirms a control as met.
- Connectors: identity providers, cloud accounts, code hosts and HR systems connect from the portal and feed the compliance checks.
- MCP gateway: read-only access over HTTPS with OAuth and PKCE for the customer's own AI assistant (compliance overview, linked evidence, open follow-ups, connectors, scan status). Tokens are revocable by the customer.
- [Trust Center](https://trust.rfi-irfos.com/): each customer's public page with the frameworks it works to and the controls its team has confirmed, for prospects and auditors.

## Services by topic

- [App security audit](https://rfi-irfos.com/app-security-audit/): Android/iOS app security audit by The Squad - decompiled build, hardcoded keys, network configuration, written report with evidence (German: /de/app-security-audit/).
- [GDPR app audit](https://rfi-irfos.com/gdpr-app-audit/): tracking before consent, data flows to third countries, special-category data, mapped to GDPR articles (German: /de/gdpr-app-audit/).
- [NIS2 for software vendors](https://rfi-irfos.com/nis2-software-vendors/): NIS2 / NISG 2026 supply-chain and risk-management duties as technical evidence about shipped software (German: /de/nis2-software-vendors/).
- [App tracker and SDK check](https://rfi-irfos.com/app-tracker-sdk-check/): every tracker and SDK in an app build - version, start time, endpoints, data categories (German: /de/app-tracker-sdk-check/).
- [AI app privacy audit](https://rfi-irfos.com/ai-app-privacy-audit/): privacy investigation of AI chatbots, assistants and AI companion apps - what the built app sends, to whom, before consent, and how minors are handled (German: /de/ai-app-privacy-audit/).
- [Managed SOC](https://rfi-irfos.com/managed-soc/): outsourced security operations center for startups up to enterprise - monitoring around the clock, incident response within one hour, fix within 24 hours down to the code (German: /de/managed-soc/).
- [Compliance automation](https://rfi-irfos.com/compliance-automation/): findings and evidence mapped to NIS2, ISO 27001 and SOC 2 controls, delivered to your auditor; no certificate issued by us (German: /de/compliance-automation/).
- [Domain Security Test](https://rfi-irfos.com/domain-security-test/): external, read-only test of a domain - DNS, TLS, e-mail protection and security headers, reviewed by a person, written report (German: /de/domain-security-test/).
- [Penetration testing](https://rfi-irfos.com/penetration-testing/): penetration testing of web apps, mobile apps, APIs, cloud and infrastructure; agents test in parallel, specialists follow the attack paths, fixes down to the code (German: /de/penetration-testing/).
- [API security testing](https://rfi-irfos.com/api-security-testing/): REST and GraphQL, authentication, authorization and attack surface (German: /de/api-security-testing/).
- [Cloud security assessment](https://rfi-irfos.com/cloud-security-assessment/): AWS and Azure misconfigurations, vulnerabilities and external attack surface (German: /de/cloud-security-assessment/).
- [Secure code review](https://rfi-irfos.com/secure-code-review/): source code and shipped-build vulnerability analysis with fixes engineered into the code (German: /de/secure-code-review/).
- [Vulnerability remediation](https://rfi-irfos.com/vulnerability-remediation/): open findings from scanners, pentests and audits turned into verified fixes down to the code, tracked on the remediation board (German: /de/vulnerability-remediation/).
- [IT security Graz](https://rfi-irfos.com/it-security-graz/): penetration testing, NIS2 consulting and a managed SOC for companies in Graz and Styria, plans from €99 a month (German: /de/it-security-graz/).
- [NIS2 consulting](https://rfi-irfos.com/nis2-consulting/): whether the NISG 2026 applies, registration within three months of 1 October 2026, and evidence for the required measures (German: /de/nis2-consulting/).
- [AI and LLM security testing](https://rfi-irfos.com/ai-llm-security-testing/): prompt injection, RAG security, agent and MCP access, guardrails and hallucination checks, mapped to the OWASP LLM Top 10 and MITRE ATLAS (German: /de/ai-llm-security-testing/).
- [Security architecture and resilience review](https://rfi-irfos.com/security-architecture-review/): defense in depth, single points of failure, redundancy and recovery, tested with fault injection and chaos engineering (German: /de/security-architecture-review/).
- [Threat intelligence](https://rfi-irfos.com/threat-intelligence/): campaign analysis, early warnings and indicators of compromise matched against the systems a customer runs (German: /de/threat-intelligence/).
- [Vendor risk management](https://rfi-irfos.com/vendor-risk-management/): due diligence, scoring, tiering and continuous monitoring of suppliers, plus answers to security questionnaires (German: /de/vendor-risk-management/).

## How it works

- [World Model](https://rfi-irfos.com/world-model/): how Dingir connects historical and real-time observations across domains into one causally structured evidence graph.
- [The Squad film](https://rfi-irfos.com/squad/film/) and [Dingir world model film](https://rfi-irfos.com/world-model/film/): short product films, each with a written description of what it shows.
- [Methodology](https://rfi-irfos.com/methodology/): how an audit actually runs - a Deep Scan of the shipped binary, with every finding traced to the code that causes it.
